name: Cherie
source:
The headmaster of Yuen Kong Kindergarten.
She is struggling to keep the school alive with only five children.
At first, she thinks that Shawn, who has come to support her, is a bit suspicious of her, but they get into a lively conversation about American comics and gradually become attracted to each other.
Although she was a bit shy about being older than Shawn, she boldly confesses her feelings to him and they start dating.
